meta.title: Press — Johan Nilsson
meta.description: A podcast on investing in fitness and the trade press in Sweden, Norway, Spain and Switzerland on Johan Nilsson and Barry’s.

sections.label: On the record
sections.sub: A podcast on investing in fitness, and the trade press in Sweden, Norway, Spain and Switzerland on each market opened.

items.t: Barry’s erobert Zürich: the first Barry’s in Switzerland
items.a: Fitness Tribune, interview with Julia Röthlisberger
items.v: How a Zürich founder found her partner on Instagram and had an answer three hours later; the opening at Talstrasse 83 in November 2025; Geneva next.
items.why: “He has enormous experience and has helped build Barry’s studios in several regions of the world.”

items.t: Zürich: Fitnesskette Barry’s eröffnet erste Schweizer Filiale
items.v: The announcement of the first Swiss studio, in Zürich’s Kreis 1.
items.why: Partners: Julia Röthlisberger and Johan Nilsson; Caro Daur as investor.

items.v: Barry’s global growth plans, with the Nordic franchise, studios in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Bergen, Oslo and Copenhagen, “with Johan Nilsson at the helm”.

items.t: Årsrapport 2022: Så gick det för Barry’s i Sverige
items.v: The Swedish company’s 2022 accounts: revenue up just over twenty per cent, two studios, Johan Nilsson as CEO.

items.t: La cadena de boutiques Barry’s aterriza en España con un club en Madrid
items.v: The licence for Spain, held with José Daniel García and Kevin Triguero; the first club in Madrid’s Salamanca district.
items.why: Named as managing director of the company in the Nordic countries.

items.t: Barry’s-franchisetagarna i Norden slås ihop och bildar regionens största boutiqueaktör
items.v: Eight studios, around 250 people, a revenue target of SEK 100 million for 2022 and a plan for sixteen studios in the Nordics.
items.why: “Proud and expectant to announce this merger.”

items.t: Barry’s skaper Nordens største aktør innen boutique fitness
items.v: The Norwegian trade press on the merger of the Swedish and Norwegian companies.

items.t: Johan Nilsson — investerare & VD Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic
items.v: An hour on strategy in the fitness sector, what an investor looks for in a concept, and Barry’s progress in the Nordics.
items.why: Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize, as investments through Stockholm Leisure Partners.

sections.d: A city for Barry’s, a concept for SLP, a seat at the board.
